items.q: What does the caption admit before the cut starts?
items.a: [[friend-as-the-gig]]. The three jobs are **自己的朋友帮忙**. The ask is a demo: 开拓一下思路. Not a stranger on a job board.

items.q: What three comment wishes become the prompt?
items.a: [[comment-constraints-as-prompt]]. No strangers. Interest-aligned. Time-free. Paste that. 阿宝 still returns warehouse QC, pet-wash, cinema backstage.

sections.title: 阿宝 as the shift lead

items.q: What is 阿宝 actually doing here?
items.a: [[ai-as-gig-playbook]]. Job board plus SOP. 收纳师 ¥100–200/hr. 喂猫 ¥30–60. Doll sofa as furniture. Siamese = 猫中之狗. Star = special client + one 万能台词.

items.q: Where did 陈泽宇's dolls go?
items.a: A transparent beanbag. Furniture is storage. **你其他东西去哪了 你别管.** He does not unpack. 我只负责收纳, 不负责还原.

items.q: What do the two houses pay?
items.a: Macau coins. Then **¥0.11** plus 蚂蚁森林 energy. The real product is the cut.

items.q: Why does he call the premiere 恐怖游轮?
items.a: [[seven-hall-loop]]. Seven halls. Same intro. 法老 stays the 保安. 陈正宇 stays the friend. The job is not getting a new line.
